reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it presents BitConnect as a way to become rich, invites viewers to join, and promotes reinvesting claimed lending profits into an active investment with a stated 290-day capital-release period. It links wealth or return claims and participation in the platform to retaining funds in its lending investment flow, although no completed withdrawal, viewer participation, or resulting loss is established.

citations.quote: My FIRST REINVESTMENT on BITCONNECT! (How To Become Rich Through Crypto)
the first thing that you are going to see today is me reinvesting my lending profits
I currently have 160 dollars in active investment
the leftover amount will be profited back to your landing wallet
capital release will be after 290 days of course

opening.argument: Judge, the speaker does not present the whole segment as a certain path to profit. He states that capital release comes after 290 days, a material limitation on access to funds. When discussing Bitcoin's price, he says, "I guess" and "We'll see," and he also notes coins that have fallen. Those qualifications matter when interpreting the title: the spoken market commentary acknowledges uncertainty and adverse price moves rather than promising that every investment will pay off.

citations.quote: capital release will be after 290 days of course
I guess it will hit 9000 today or tomorrow... We'll see...
Bitcoin Cash has Fallen 0.91%
My FIRST REINVESTMENT on BITCONNECT! (How To Become Rich Through Crypto)

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited reinvestment and active-investment statements describe what the speaker says he did; neither establishes that he promises viewers the same result. The 290-day release term is a restriction he discloses, not something he conceals. The title's wealth framing deserves scrutiny, but the opening overlooks his explicit uncertainty about a price prediction and his discussion of falling prices.

citations.quote: capital release will be after 290 days of course
I guess it will hit 9000 today or tomorrow... We'll see...

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Uncertainty about tomorrow's Bitcoin price is not a warning about the lending arrangement. The speaker invites viewers to join BitConnect while presenting reinvestment of claimed lending profits as part of a video titled as a route to becoming rich. Disclosing the 290-day capital-release period does not change that promotional investment message.

citations.quote: Join Bitconnect: http://www.bit.ly/cryptoyt
me reinvesting my lending profits
My FIRST REINVESTMENT on BITCONNECT! (How To Become Rich Through Crypto)
capital release will be after 290 days of course

opening.argument: Judge, most of the spoken account is a first-person walkthrough of an interface. The speaker identifies a balance in his lending wallet, describes clicking the reinvest button, explains what happens to a leftover amount, and reports the updated active-investment figure after refreshing. That sequence can be understood as showing viewers how the operation works, not instructing them to commit their own money. The video then moves to cryptocurrency prices and charts, reinforcing its demonstration-and-commentary character.

citations.quote: So I now have 10.10 dollars in my lending wallet.
It's fairly easy to do, you just need to click on this blue button that says reinvest.
the leftover amount will be profited back to your landing wallet
i now have 170 dollars in active investment

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening treats a walkthrough as though its instructional detail necessarily solicits a deposit. Yet the cited sequence follows the speaker's own wallet balance and his own reinvestment; it does not show a viewer investing or receiving a return. The release period supplies operational context for the demonstrated transaction. Even the wealth-oriented title does not by itself establish that the reported balance is independently verified.

citations.quote: So I now have 10.10 dollars in my lending wallet.
capital release will be after 290 days of course
My FIRST REINVESTMENT on BITCONNECT! (How To Become Rich Through Crypto)

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A demonstration can also promote participation. Here the walkthrough shows how to reinvest claimed lending profits, celebrates a higher active-investment figure, and sits alongside an express invitation to join BitConnect. The absence of a demonstrated viewer deposit or independently verified return does not erase the video's invitation and favorable presentation of the lending flow.

citations.quote: the first thing that you are going to see today is me reinvesting my lending profits
i now have 170 dollars in active investment so that's really good
Join Bitconnect: http://www.bit.ly/cryptoyt

opening.argument: Judge, the description contains a join link and a separate discount code for Genesis Mining. Those are recognizable referral and promotional details, but their presence does not establish what happens to anyone who follows the link. The speaker reports reinvesting his own stated wallet balance; the supplied account does not show a viewer depositing funds, handing over credentials, earning downline income, or receiving a guaranteed return. A promotional link and an account demonstration are not, on their own, proof of those additional mechanisms.

citations.quote: Join Bitconnect: http://www.bit.ly/cryptoyt Use the code '8VxCBA' and get a 3% discount on Genesis Mining!
So I now have 10.10 dollars in my lending wallet.
So now I am going to reinvest my profits.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening identifies a join invitation, claimed profits, and a release term, but does not establish a completed viewer transaction or a promised fixed return. The discount code concerns Genesis Mining, not a stated BitConnect return. The evidence supports calling this promotion; it does not, without more, show every mechanism the opening invites the judge to infer.

citations.quote: Join Bitconnect: http://www.bit.ly/cryptoyt Use the code '8VxCBA' and get a 3% discount on Genesis Mining!
capital release will be after 290 days of course

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The case does not depend on a credential request, downline payment, or completed viewer loss. The BitConnect invitation appears alongside a title promising a route to wealth and a walkthrough that presents lending profits as available to reinvest, with capital released only after 290 days. The separate discount offer does not make that investment promotion an ordinary discount video.
